watchlistHint: Current gold price in each market. Tap a country to use it in the calculator.
addCountryHint: Rates and taxes are indicative starting points — edit them any time.
noMatch: No match — add a custom country below.
noCountries: No countries yet. Add one to start comparing.
homeTitleC: costs — before you pay for it.
homeIntro: Check a shop's price, see what you would get back when you sell, and keep track of your gold. Gold and workmanship in plain numbers.
noSignup: No sign-up. Installable on your phone.
checkPriceHint: Enter the details below to see whether the seller's price is reasonable.
costHint: Cheapest first. Bars separate metal, shop mark-up, and duty or tax.
sellHint: What cash should you get when the shop buys your gold back?
vaultHint: Your gold, valued at the latest price. Saved on this device only.
emptyVault: Nothing here yet. Add a piece below or from the Calculator.
forecastTitle: Where gold may be next week
forecastHint: A likely range for the coming week, based on how jumpy gold has been lately.
forecastRange: About 8 in 10 times, gold ends the week between
forecastStale: This data is a few days old.
forecastDisclaimer: A range from past volatility, not a prediction of direction. Not financial advice.
spotFarFromClose: Your spot price is quite different from the latest market close.
historyNote: Daily closes of gold futures (real data), through
historyMarkup: Shop mark-up shown is today's rate applied to every day.
dcaTitle: What if I'd bought gold every month?
dcaHint: Replay real prices: buy a little gold on the first trading day of each month, and compare it with putting the same cash in a savings account.
dcaSavingsHint: Your bank's or fixed deposit's rate. 3% is only a starting guess.
dcaChartTitle: Cash in, gold and savings over time
dcaNoteToday: Past exchange rates aren't available for this currency, so today's rate is used for every month. Switch the display currency to MYR or USD for exact history.
dcaNoteClamped: Only {{n}} of {{m}} monthly purchases fit the price history (it starts {{date}}).
dcaNoteShop: Prices include shop mark-up, duty and tax for {{country}}; the sold-today value takes off the usual deduction (susut).
dcaNoteRaw: Prices are raw gold prices with no shop mark-up. Switch to Shop price in view options for a more realistic shop purchase.
dcaDisclaimer: A replay of the past, not a forecast. This period includes a large gold rally. Prices are daily closes of gold futures from {{from}} to {{to}} (New York trading days).
dcaNoData: Not enough price history to run this plan.
dcaUnavailable: Price history couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
dcaNoteHistorical: Ringgit amounts use the market USD/MYR rate on each purchase date (latest {{rate}}). Your watchlist's rate can differ, so today's values here may not match other pages.
keyHint: By default Paun shows the latest daily close of gold. For a live price, paste your free GoldAPI key (goldapi.io, 100 free requests a month). Requests go straight from your browser and the key stays here.
priceTipMarket: Latest daily close of gold futures. Add a GoldAPI key in Settings for a live price.
priceTipLive: Live price fetched with your GoldAPI key.
priceTipManual: A price you entered in Settings.
priceTipPlaceholder: No price source could be reached yet, so this is a placeholder. Set a price in Settings or check your connection.
chartUnavailable: Price history is unavailable right now. Check your connection and try again.
historyTz: Dates are New York trading days.
scanIntro: Take or choose a photo. Paun reads it and fills in the form below. Nothing is saved until you press Add.
scanWaitCheck: Checking that you are a person…
scanErrBusy: The scanner has reached its limit for today. Please try again tomorrow, or add the piece by hand.
scanErrLimit: You have scanned a lot in the last hour. Please wait a little, or add the piece by hand.
scanErrTurnstile: We could not confirm that you are a person. Please try the check again.
scanErrRejected: The scanner cannot read that photo. Please try a different one.
scanErrNetwork: Could not reach the scanner. Check your connection and try again.
scanErrDecode: Could not open that photo. Please try a JPEG or PNG.
scanErrUnavailable: The scanner is not available right now. Please add the piece by hand.
scanNotReceipt: This does not look like a gold receipt or hallmark. Please try a clearer photo.
scanHardToRead: Some details were hard to read, so please check every field.
scanUnknownCurrency: The receipt is in {{currency}}, which is not in your watchlist, so please type the price paid yourself.
scanBetaTip: New, can make mistakes. Check every field.
scanPrivacyShared: Your photo is sent to Google's Gemini to be read; Paun does not store it. Paun uses Google's free tier, where Google may use submitted content to improve its products. To use your own terms, add your own Gemini key in Settings.
scanPrivacyOwn: Your photo is sent to Google's Gemini using your own key, under your Google account's terms. Paun does not store it.
scanErrOwnKey: Google did not accept your Gemini key. Check it in Settings (it should be a key from Google AI Studio).
scanErrOwnQuota: Your Gemini key has used up its allowance for now. Try again later, or remove it in Settings to use Paun's shared scanner.
geminiKeyLabel: Gemini key (optional, for the receipt scanner)
geminiKeyHint: Without a key, scans use Paun's shared free Gemini key, where Google may use your photo to improve its products. With your own key, scans fall under your Google account's terms (a paid key keeps your photos out of Google's training; a free key may not). Paun never keeps your key: it stays in this browser and passes through Paun's server only to reach Google.
geminiKeyGet: Get a key from Google AI Studio
geminiKeySession: This session only (forgotten when the browser closes)
geminiKeyInvalid: That does not look like a Gemini key. It is about 39 characters of letters, numbers, - and _.
geminiKeyNotSaved: This browser would not let Paun remember the key. It will not be used.
scanReviewHint: Check each piece. Remove any that is not gold with the minus button, add one the scanner missed, then add them to your vault. Nothing is saved until you press the button at the bottom.
scanPending: Finish adding or discard the scanned receipt first.
scanTotalsDiffer: The prices do not add up to the receipt total. Check each line, or a charge such as transport that is not a piece.
scanRowInvalid: Please fill in the weight and choose the purity.
scanNoDate: No date was printed on the receipt, so today's date is used. Change it if needed.
scanNoPieces: No gold pieces were found on this receipt. Add them by hand below.
acctHint: Sign in with Google to keep your Vault, settings and country watchlist in step across your devices. Everything works without it.
acctPrivacy: Paun keeps your name, email and photo link from Google, nothing else, and never your Google password. You can delete the account at any time.
acctSignOutNote: Signing out keeps your pieces and settings on this device.
acctDelete: Delete my account and all synced data
acctDeleteBody: This removes your account and everything Paun's server holds for it. Your Vault and settings on this device are not touched. This cannot be undone.
acctOffline: Could not reach Paun's server. Your sign-in is kept and will be checked again.
acctErrNetwork: Could not reach Paun's server. Check your connection and try again.
acctErrRejected: That sign-in was not accepted. Please try again.
acctErrLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
acctErrUnavailable: Sign-in is not available right now.
acctGoogleBlocked: Google's sign-in could not load. An ad blocker or the network may be blocking it.
syncOffline: Offline. Your changes will sync when you are back online.
syncError: Could not sync just now. It will try again.
syncRateLimited: Too many syncs in the last hour. It will catch up later.
syncLimit: Your account holds the maximum of 2,000 pieces. Remove some, then sync again.
syncSignedOut: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
syncSkipped: {{n}} piece(s) were left out because their details are not valid.
syncMerged: Added {{n}} piece(s) from your account to this device.
buyHint: Type what the shop tells you. Paun checks the sum and shows what is gold and what is workmanship.
shopRate: Shop's rate for this purity, per gram ({{cur}})
soldBackHere: If you sold it back to this shop (optional)
susutOfSell: Susut (% off the shop's selling rate)
orSusut: Or, if the shop speaks in susut: give its selling rate and its susut %.
metalValueToday: Metal value today: {{value}} per gram of {{purity}} (not a shop price)
priceMissing: No gold price or exchange rate yet. Check your connection or set the price in Settings.
enterShopRate: Enter the shop's rate per gram to check the price.
quoteMore: {{amount}} more than the rate and upah explain. Ask the shop what the extra is.
quoteLess: {{amount}} less than the rate and upah explain.
realRate: Rate you are really paying: {{rate}} per gram.
shopMargin: Shop's margin on the gold, over the metal value
overMetal: Paid over the metal value, gold margin and upah together
upahShare: Upah as a share of the total
basisSusut: at its selling rate less {{pct}}% susut
roundTrip: Buying and selling back here costs {{amount}}. Upah is not returned.
sellEstimateNote: An estimate from the metal value less 3%. Ask the shop for its buy-back rate or susut %.
offerMatches: The offer matches what the shop's own rate gives.
offerBelow: The offer is {{amount}} below what the shop's rate gives.
offerAbove: The offer is {{amount}} above what the shop's rate gives.
impliedSusut: The same as a susut of {{pct}}% off its selling rate
impliedBuyBack: The same as a buy-back rate of {{rate}} per gram
tradeInGain: Trading in gives {{credit}} of credit, {{gain}} more than cash. The credit counts only towards a new piece.
upahNotReturned: The upah you paid when you bought is not returned when you sell.
compareHint: Enter what each shop quotes for this piece. Rates are per gram for the purity above.
needOneQuote: Enter at least one shop's rate per gram.
roundTripTitle: Buy and sell back here costs
compareFoot: Sell here counts only shops that gave a buy-back rate. Upah is never returned.
countryRough: A rough price for {{weight}} g of {{purity}} at a counter in each country.
countryNote: Rough estimates with an assumed shop margin of 5%. They are not quotes, and selling gold abroad is rarely practical. Use Buy here / Sell here in the price check to compare real shops.
paidConvertedNote: Prices paid in another currency are shown at today's exchange rate (marked ≈).
sellMore: The shop quotes susut instead, or you are trading in
moreMarketsHint: The gold price over time and a likely range for the coming week.
moreDcaHint: What if you had bought gold every month?
moreCountriesHint: A rough price for the same piece in other countries.
modeHint: Simple: the answer. Pro: more detail, and the country list you can edit.
homeFeat1Body: Type the shop's rate and upah. See if the total adds up, and what is gold and what is workmanship.
homeFeat2Body: Type the shop's buy-back rate or its susut. See what you should get, against what it offered.
homeFeat3Body: Put up to four shops side by side: where it costs least to buy, and where it pays most to sell.
homeFeat4Body: No account. Your gold and your settings stay on this device, and you can export them any time.
homeExampleLabel: Example · {{grams}} g of 916 at today's price, shop rate {{margin}}% over the metal, upah {{upah}}% of the gold
homeFooter: Paun · Estimates only, not financial advice. Data stays in your browser.
moreCheckHint: Check a shop's price or an offer.
moreVaultHint: The gold you own and what it is worth.
moreGuideHint: How a jewellery price is built.
settingsResetToast: Everything is back to the defaults.
settingsErrRate: Enter the exchange rate for the display currency.
settingsErrFetch: Could not fetch the live price ({{reason}}). Your price is still in use.
currencyAllUsd: All figures are shown in US dollars.
currencyNeedsRate: This currency is not in your country list. Enter its rate per 1 USD below.
currencyFromList: Converted at the {{cur}} rate from your country list.
dockHint: Choose what sits in the bar and in what order. Everything else is under More.
dockFull: The dock is full. Move something to More first.
